new_assertions.body: A direct collision in the complete frozen coordinate is stronger than failure of any finite polynomial degree over that coordinate; degree escalation cannot restore information that the coordinate has already identified.
The 4x5-k4 obstruction is count-theoretic before it is higher-order: parity erases a pair substitution because multiplicity two maps to zero.
Full exact component multiplicity remaining Q-V exact while parity fails isolates a quotient boundary inside component counts rather than a failure of the component multiset representation.

The minimum parity collision changes two copies of one component type into two copies of another at the same exact rank; any repaired count quotient must distinguish that even-positive mass from zero.
Modulo-3, modulo-4, and modulo-6 exactness on 4x5-k4 are finite count-residue sufficiency controls, not evidence that any one modulus is universally canonical.
The next compression search should refine multiplicity parity minimally by preserving whether an even count is zero or positive before introducing a larger generic modulus.
